title: 政府来电核实托儿补贴收入估算
titleEn: A call from Centrelink about your family income estimate
scene: 你的孩子上 childcare，每两周能拿到政府的托儿补贴（Child Care Subsidy，CCS）。周二上午你正在上班，手机上来了一个 No Caller ID 的电话。对方说自己是 Services Australia（大家习惯叫 Centrelink）的 Narelle：你在系统里填的家庭收入估算可能太低了，将来可能要还钱。她说话很快，还有不少政府办事用语。
你的目标：① 先礼貌地确认这个电话是真的，不要随便报银行或密码信息；② 听懂为什么要更新估算，以及不更新的后果；③ 问清楚去哪里改、什么时候之前改好，并请对方把内容发到 myGov 信箱。

facts.v: Narelle：Services Australia 家庭补助部门的工作人员
系统里的家庭收入估算是 $120,000，今年实际大约 $140,000
估算太低，补贴多发，报税对账（reconciliation）后可能要还钱
两周内在 myGov 的 Centrelink 账户里更新估算，并按时报税

vocab.en: No Caller ID / a private number
vocab.ex: It came up as a private number, so I nearly didn't answer.

vocab.zh: 澳洲政府福利服务机构（口语常说 Centrelink）
vocab.ex: Services Australia runs Centrelink and Medicare.
Our Child Care Subsidy goes straight to the centre.

vocab.zh: 家庭收入估算（你预计的全年家庭收入）
vocab.ex: I need to update our family income estimate on myGov.
Our combined income went up this year.
Have you got your CRN handy?
The address we've got on file is in Prospect.
Your estimate looks a bit under the mark.

vocab.zh: 年度对账（报税后核算补贴多发或少发）
vocab.ex: They do the reconciliation after you lodge your tax return.

vocab.zh: 结果欠下一笔钱（要还给政府）
vocab.ex: If you don't update it, you could end up with a debt.
Make sure you both lodge your tax returns on time.
Can you get it done within a fortnight?

listening.en: G'day, it's Narelle calling from Services Australia. Have I caught you at an okay time?
listening.sound: caught you 连读成 “cor-chya”；Have I 很轻，几乎只听到 “av-eye”。这是在问你现在方便吗
listening.zh: 你好，我是 Services Australia 的 Narelle。现在方便说话吗？
listening.reply: Yes, I've got a few minutes. What's it about?

listening.en: Totally fair question, love. You can hang up and ring us back on the number on our website if you'd rather.
listening.sound: if you'd rather 连读成 “if-ya-RAH-tha”，意思是“如果你更愿意这样”；love 是部分年长澳洲人的亲切称呼，不用在意
listening.zh: 这个问题问得很合理。你愿意的话，可以挂掉，再打我们官网上的号码回拨。
listening.reply: Thanks. Could you send something to my myGov inbox first?

listening.en: Have you got your CRN handy, or will I just go through a few security questions with you?
listening.sound: CRN 读字母 C-R-N；handy 这里是“手边有”；will I 在这里相当于 shall I，是澳洲常见的说法
listening.zh: 你手边有 CRN 吗？还是我问你几个身份核实问题？
listening.reply: I don't have it with me. Security questions are fine, but I won't give out any passwords.

listening.en: So what's come through is your combined income's looking a fair bit higher than what you've got in there.
listening.sound: what's come through 指“系统传过来的信息”；a fair bit 读 “a-FAIR-bit”，意思是“不少”；句子连得很紧，抓住 higher 就明白了
listening.zh: 系统显示的信息是，你们的合计收入看起来比你填的高出不少。
listening.reply: Oh, right. Yes, I started a new job this year, so that makes sense.

listening.en: If it's under the mark, you've been getting more than you're entitled to, and that'll catch up with you at reconciliation.
listening.sound: entitled to 是“有资格得到”；catch up with you 连读成 “catchup-with-ya”，意思是“之后会找上你”，这里指到时要还钱
listening.zh: 如果估算偏低，你拿到的补贴就比应得的多，到年度对账时就得算回来。
listening.reply: So I might have to pay some of it back?

listening.en: No dramas, just pop it in your myGov when you get a sec, and that'll sort it for the next lot of payments.
listening.sound: pop it in 是“填进去”；when you get a sec 读 “wen-ya-get-a-SEC”；the next lot of 就是“下一批”
listening.zh: 没关系，有空的时候在 myGov 里填上就行，下一批补贴就会按新的算了。
listening.reply: Okay, I'll do that tonight. Is there a deadline?

speech.topic: 讲一次你接到陌生官方电话的经历，以及你怎么处理
paragraphs: Today I'd like to talk about a phone call that made me a bit nervous. Last week, I was at work when my phone rang. The screen said No Caller ID. Usually I don't answer those calls, but this time I picked up.

The woman said she was from Services Australia. She told me there was a problem with our family income estimate for childcare. To be honest, my first thought was that it might be a scam. We all get so many fake calls these days. So I took a deep breath and asked her how I could know the call was real.

I was surprised by her answer. She said it was a very fair question, and she told me I could hang up and call back on the number on the official website. She also sent a message to my myGov inbox while we were talking. When I saw that message, I felt much better.

After that, she explained the problem. I started a new job this year, so our income had gone up, but I had forgotten to change the number in the system. If I didn't fix it, we could end up with a debt later. I asked her to slow down twice, and she was happy to do that.

That night, I logged in and updated the estimate. It only took five minutes. I learned two things from this call. First, it's okay to check who is calling before you give out your details. Second, it's okay to ask people to repeat things. A good call is not a fast call. It's a clear one.
speech.zh: 我想讲一通让我有点紧张的电话。上周上班时手机响了，显示不显示号码，这次我接了。对方说自己是 Services Australia 的，我们的托儿补贴家庭收入估算有问题。我第一反应是诈骗，于是深吸一口气，问她怎么证明电话是真的。没想到她说这个问题很合理，我可以挂掉再打官网上的号码，通话时她还往我的 myGov 信箱发了一条消息，我这才放心。她解释说我今年换了新工作，收入涨了，但我忘了改系统里的数字，不改以后可能要还钱。我请她放慢语速两次，她都很乐意。当晚我登录改好了，只花了五分钟。我学到两点：给信息前先核实对方身份没问题；请别人重复也没问题。好的电话不是快，而是清楚。

patterns.en: Before I give out any details, could you ___?
patterns.zh: 在我提供任何信息之前，您能……吗？

patterns.en: If I didn't ___, we could end up with ___.
patterns.zh: 如果我不……，我们可能落得……

patterns.en: I learned that it's okay to ___.

lines.en: G'day, it's Narelle calling from Services Australia. Have I caught you at an okay time?
lines.zh: 你好，我是 Services Australia 的 Narelle。现在方便说话吗？

lines.en: Hi Narelle. I'm at work, but I've got a few minutes. Sorry, what's this about?
lines.zh: 你好 Narelle。我在上班，不过有几分钟。请问是什么事？

lines.en: Yeah, no worries. It's about your Child Care Subsidy. Nothing to panic about, but your family income estimate needs a bit of a look.
lines.zh: 好的，没事。是关于你的托儿补贴。不用慌，只是你的家庭收入估算需要看一下。

lines.en: Okay. Before I give out any details, how do I know this is a genuine call? It came up as No Caller ID.
lines.zh: 好的。在我提供任何信息之前，我怎么知道这个电话是真的？来电没有显示号码。

lines.en: Totally fair question, love. You can hang up and ring us back on the number on our website if you'd rather. Or I can pop a message in your myGov inbox right now. Which'd suit?
lines.zh: 这个问题问得很合理。你愿意的话，可以挂掉，再打我们官网上的号码回拨。或者我现在往你的 myGov 信箱发一条消息。哪种方便？

lines.en: A message would be great, thanks. I'll check the app while we talk.
lines.zh: 发消息吧，谢谢。我们说话时我看一下 app。

lines.en: Righto, that's gone through now. Should be there in a tick.
lines.zh: 好，已经发过去了。马上就能收到。

lines.en: Yes, I can see it. Thanks for that.
lines.zh: 嗯，我看到了。谢谢。

lines.en: Beauty. Now, have you got your CRN handy, or will I just go through a few security questions with you?
lines.zh: 太好了。那你手边有 CRN 吗？还是我问你几个身份核实问题？

lines.en: I don't have it with me. Questions are fine, but I won't give out any passwords or bank details.
lines.zh: 我手边没有。问问题可以，但我不会提供密码或银行信息。

lines.en: Good on you, and I'd never ask for those. Can I just get your date of birth and the address we've got on file?
lines.zh: 做得对，我也绝不会问这些。麻烦告诉我你的出生日期，和我们系统里的地址。

lines.en: Sure. It's the third of June, 1987, and the address is 14 Wattle Street, Prospect.
lines.zh: 好的。1987 年 6 月 3 日，地址是 Prospect 区 Wattle Street 14 号。

lines.en: Lovely, that's all matching up. So what's come through is your combined income's looking a fair bit higher than what you've got in there. You've put one-twenty, and we're seeing closer to one-forty.
lines.zh: 好的，都对得上。系统显示的是，你们的合计收入比你填的高出不少。你填的是十二万，我们看到的接近十四万。

lines.en: Sorry, could you say that again a bit slower? Did you say one-forty or one-fourteen?
lines.zh: 不好意思，能再说慢一点吗？您说的是十四万还是十一万四？

lines.en: Yep, sorry, I do rabbit on. One hundred and forty thousand, combined, for this financial year.
lines.zh: 哦，抱歉，我说话太快了。十四万，是合计收入，这个财年的。

lines.en: Oh, right. That makes sense. I started a new job this year, and I forgot to change it.
lines.zh: 哦，明白了。那就对了。我今年换了新工作，忘记改了。

lines.en: Happens all the time. Thing is, if it's under the mark, you've been getting more than you're entitled to, and that'll catch up with you at reconciliation.
lines.zh: 这很常见。问题是，如果估算偏低，你拿到的补贴就比应得的多，到年度对账时就得算回来。

lines.en: Just to confirm, you mean we might have to pay some of the money back?
lines.zh: 我确认一下，您的意思是我们可能要还一部分钱？

lines.en: Yeah, you could end up with a debt, unfortunately. But if you fix it now, it'll be a lot smaller, or there might be nothing to pay at all.
lines.zh: 对，很遗憾可能会欠一笔钱。但现在改的话，金额会小很多，甚至可能完全不用还。

lines.en: Okay. Where do I change it? And is there a deadline?
lines.zh: 好的。在哪里改？有截止时间吗？

lines.en: Easiest way's through myGov. Go into your Centrelink account and there's a spot for your family income estimate. No dramas, just pop it in when you get a sec. If you could get it done within a fortnight, that'd be ideal.
lines.zh: 最简单的是通过 myGov。进你的 Centrelink 账户，里面有填家庭收入估算的地方。没关系，有空的时候填上就行。最好两周内弄好。

lines.en: Within two weeks, got it. Could you please put all of that in a message to my myGov inbox, so I have it in writing?
lines.zh: 两周内，明白了。能麻烦您把这些内容都发到我的 myGov 信箱吗？这样我有书面记录。

lines.en: Absolutely, I'll chuck it in there as soon as we hang up. And don't forget, you and your partner both need to lodge your tax returns, or the reconciliation can't happen.
lines.zh: 没问题，挂了电话我就发过去。还有别忘了，你和伴侣都要报税，不然没法做年度对账。

lines.en: Sure, we'll do that. Thanks so much for your help, Narelle.
lines.zh: 好的，我们会的。非常感谢您的帮助，Narelle。

lines.en: No worries at all. Have a good one, bye now.
lines.zh: 不客气。祝你今天愉快，再见。

rescue.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again a bit slower, please?
rescue.zh: 不好意思，我没听清。能再说慢一点吗？

rescue.en: Before I give out any details, how can I check that this call is genuine?
rescue.zh: 在我提供信息之前，我怎么核实这个电话是真的？

rescue.en: Could you spell that for me, please?
Just to confirm, the deadline is two weeks from today, is that right?
rescue.zh: 我确认一下，截止时间是今天起两周内，对吗？

rescue.en: Could you send that to my myGov inbox, so I have it in writing?
rescue.zh: 能发到我的 myGov 信箱吗？这样我有书面记录。

checklist: 能听懂 No Caller ID、your CRN handy、on file 这些开场和核实身份的说法
能礼貌地问 How do I know this is a genuine call?，并说明不提供密码和银行信息
能分清 one-forty 和 one-fourteen 这类容易听混的数字，听不清就马上问
能听懂 under the mark、reconciliation、end up with a debt 的意思和后果
能问清楚去哪里改、什么时候之前改好
结束前能请对方把内容发到 myGov 信箱，留下书面记录
